test_pca_basic_fit_transform: test PCA fit, transform, and fit_transform equivalence on iris dataset with all SVD solvers
test_pca_sparse_input: test PCA produces identical results for sparse and dense input matrices with arpack and covariance_eigh solvers
test_pca_whitening: test PCA whitening produces unit-variance output components with all SVD solvers
test_pca_solver_equivalence: test all PCA SVD solvers produce consistent results for tall, wide, rank-deficient data with and without whitening
test_pca_mle_dimension_inference: test PCA n_components='mle' automatically infers correct dimensionality from eigenvalue spectrum
